summary: Security-fix regression session (SEC-001..SEC-004). Backend pytest 11/11 passed via /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py. UI regression via Playwright: raihan & kalgen logins still work post-fix, all 7 main pages (Dashboard/Pemantauan/PRF/Penerimaan/Data LIS/Master Reagen/Kelola Pengguna) load without errors, Master Reagen search accepts regex-special chars ('.*', '(a+)+') without crash/hang, WhatsApp jadwal card + '07:00 WIB' schedule text still render on Dashboard. Change-password UI flow on a throwaway koordinator account confirmed: after clicking Simpan the user is auto-logged-out (returned to Login page), old password no longer works, new password logs in successfully. Deleted user's token gets 401 on next API call (verified via API). LIS import correctly rejects >10MB and wrong-extension files with 400.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.seed_accounts() now correctly only inserts missing accounts — password rotations survive backend restarts (SEC-001 fixed).
get_current_user does exactly one extra Mongo lookup per request to re-validate token_version — acceptable overhead; consider a per-request cache if hot-path latency becomes an issue at scale.
server.py list_reagen uses re.escape(query[:200]) — ReDoS mitigated (SEC-003).
LIS import enforces MAX_LIS_FILES=50 and 10MB/file — 11MB file rejected with clean 400 (SEC-004).
change_password uses $inc token_version — invalidates ALL existing sessions for that user across devices (SEC-002).
delete_user removes the DB doc so the next request bearing a token from that user hits the 'Akun tidak ditemukan' 401 branch — correct (SEC-002).
Nit: change_password does not enforce that new != old password; not a security bug per se but a minor UX improvement.
Nit: LIS import reads full file into memory before size check via f.read(); for very large uploads consider streaming/chunked read — current 10MB cap makes this acceptable.
